Q3 FY26 Outlook
Key Announcements This Quarter
Europe Builds Over 3,000 Exaflops of NVIDIA AI Infrastructure to Fuel Region's Next Industrial Transformation

NVIDIA is working with European nations,and technology and industry leaders, to build NVIDlA Blackwell Al infrastructure that will strengthen digital sovereignty, support economic growth and position the continent as a leader in the Al industrial revolution In France, Mistral Al is building an end-to-end cloud platform powered by 18K NVIDlA Grace Blackwell systems in the first phase, with plans to expand across multiple sites in 2026
In the U.K., NVIDIA Cloud Partners Nebius and Nscale announced the first phase of their Al infrastructure development plans to deploy 14K Blackwell GPUs to power new data centers
In Germany, NViDlA and partners are building the world's first industrial Al cloud for European manufacturers, powered by DGX B200 systems and RTX PRO Servers
These deployments will enable the EU to securely develop, train and deploy agentic and physical Al applications
EU plans to invest 2OB Euros to establish 2O Al factories including 5 "gigafactories," to increase its Al compute infrastructure 10x
NVIDIA Partners With Europe Model Builders and Cloud Providers to Accelerate Region's Leap Into Al
NVIDIA is teaming with model builders and cloud providers across Europe and the Middle East to optimize sovereign LLMs, helping to accelerate enterprise Al adoption for the region's industries
Model builders and Al consortiums are using NVIDIA Nemotron, to maximize model cost efficiency and accuracy for enterprise Al workloads, including agentic Al
Model post-training and inference will run on Al infrastructure in Europe from NVIDIA Cloud Partners with DGX Cloud Lepton
The open, sovereign models will provide a foundation for an integrated regional Al ecosystem that reflects local languages and culture
NVIDIA Partners With Novo Nordisk and DCAl to Advance Drug Discovery
NVIDIA and Novo Nordisk are collaborating to accelerate drug discovery through innovative Al use cases
Novo Nordisk will use the Gefion sovereign Al supercomputer - powered by NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD- for running drug discovery and agentic Al workloads
Andalso:

NVIDIA BioNeMo for generative Al-powered drug discovery NVIDIA NiM and NeMo for building customized agentic workflows NVIDIA Omniverse to create physically accurate simulation environments for developing physical Al applications
Will use NVIDIA BioNeMo, NIM, and NeMo to create customized generative Al models and Al agents that can be used for early research and clinical development
NVIDIA Omniverse will be used to apply advanced simulation and physical Al technologies
Siemens and NVIDIA Expand Partnership to Accelerate Al Capabilities in Manufacturing
Siemens and NVIDlA announced an expansion of their partnership to accelerate the next era of industrial Al and digitalization and enable the factory of the future
The partnership empowers industrial companies to leverage Alpowered technologies for next-gen factory automation
Advanced Al agents will work seamlessly across the Siemens Industrial Copilot portfolio, executing entire Al-powered processes without human intervention
Siemens' Operations Copilot brings generative Al to shopfloor operators; optimized to run on premises with NVIDlA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs
Siemens is also integrating NVIDlA BlueField DPUs for Al-driven cybersecurity
SIEMENS
NVIDIA DGX Cloud Lepton Connects Europe's Developers to Global NVIDlA Compute Ecosystem

NVIDIA is expanding NVIDIA DGX Cloud Lepton一 an Al platform featuring a global compute marketplace that connects developers building agentic and physical Al applications 一 with GPUs now available from a growing network of cloud providers
Mistral Al,Nebius, Nscale, Firebird, Fluidstack,Hydra Host, Scaleway and Together Ai are now contributing NVIDlA Blackwell and other NVIDIA architecture GPUs to the marketplace
AWS and Microsoft Azure will be the first large-scale cloud providers to participate in DGX Cloud Lepton, joining CoreWeave, Crusoe, Firmus,Foxconn, GMl Cloud, Lambda and Yotta Data Services
Hugging Face is introducing Training Cluster as a Service, seamlessly connecting Al researchers and developers building foundation models with the NVIDIA compute ecosystem
NVIDlA Blackwell Delivers Breakthrough Performance in Latest MLPerf Training Results

NVIDIA Al platform delivered the highest performance at scale on every benchmark and powered every result submitted on the benchmark's toughest large language model (LLM)-focused test: Llama 3.1 4O5B pretraining - first MLPerf training submissions using NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 systems
NVIDIA was the only platform to submit results on every MLPerf Training v5.O benchmark- underscoring its exceptionall performance and versatility
These performance leaps highlight advancements in Blackwell that enable faster and more cost-effective training

NVIDIA is working with companies worldwide to build out Al factories - speeding the training and deployment of next-gen agentic Al applications that produce tokens and intelligence that can be applied to almost every industry and academic domain
OpenAl and NVIDIA Propel Al Innovation With New Open Models Optimized for the World's Largest AiInference Infrastructure
OpenAl's two new open-weight Al reasoning models, oss-120b and gpt-oss-2Ob, bring cutting-edge Al development to developers, enthusiasts, enterprises, startups and governments everywhere
This collaboration highlights the power of community-driven innovation and NViDiA's foundational role in making Al accessible worldwide
The models were trained on NVIDIA H1oO GPUs and run inference best on the hundreds of millions of GPUs running the NVIDIA CUDA platform
With software optimizations, the models offer optimal inference on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 systems, achieving industry leading 1.5M tokens per second, driving massive efficiency for inference

These air-cooled, PCle-based systems integrate seamlessly into standard IT environments
They run traditional enterprise IT applications as well as the most advanced agentic and physical Al applications
Enterprises can achieve up to 45x better performance and 18x higher energy efficiency when running enterprise workloads
Nearly 90 companies including many global leaders are already adopting RTX PRO servers

New NVIDlA Omniverse libraries and Cosmos world foundation models (WFMs) accelerate the development and deployment of physical Al and robotics solutions

Boston Dynamics,Disney Research, Figure AI, Hexagon, RAl Institute, Lightwheel and Skild Al are adopting Omniverse libraries, Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab to accelerate their Al robotics development, while Amazon Devices & Services is using them to power a new manufacturing solution
Cosmos Reason is being used by Magna, and adopted by VAST Data,Milestone Systems and Linker Vision for autonomous delivery vehicles,automated traffic monitoring, visual inspectior

NVIDIA Blackwell-Powered Jetson Thor Now Available, the Ultimate Platform for Physical Al & Robotics

These powerful new robotics computers are built for generative reasoning and designed to power millions of robots across diverse industries including manufacturing, logistics,agriculture, transportation, healthcare, and retail
With over 2,0o0 teraflops of Al compute,it unlocks new capabilities such as simultaneous processing of multiple Al workstreams and real-time inference.
Agility Robotics, Amazon Robotics, Boston Dynamics, Caterpillar, Figure, Hexagon, Medtronic and Meta are among the early Jetson Thoradopters
